versions.content: Communication patterns for sender-receiver communica- tion PortPrototype s typed by a SenderReceiverInterface may be connected to establish a 1:n (i.e. one sender, multiple receivers) communication relationship. It is also possible to establish an n:1 (i.e. many senders, one receiver) communication pattern.
